Contact.title: Contact
Contact.description: Represents a contact in the contact management module.

companyName.description: The name of the company the contact is associated with.

contactPerson.description: The name of the contact person.

province.description: The province where the contact is located.

status.description: The current status of the contact.

firstContactDate.description: The date the first contact was made.

nextAction.description: A description of the next action to be taken with this contact.

nextActionDate.description: The date the next action should be taken.

listName.description: The name of the list the contact belongs to.

source.description: The source where the contact was found (e.g., URL, event).

/users/{userId}/contacts/{contactId}.description: Stores contact information for each user.
